title: Comms Blackout
subtitle: Test your grasp of Comms Blackout — White Hat Frequency Fracture, The First 72 Hours, NPC code glitch, Sol memory sharpening, EBS readiness, Real Craft path, and Second Realm restoration.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Comms Blackout is a controlled White Hat Frequency Fracture that severs parasitic feeds, clears the field, and opens The First 72 Hours. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Comms Blackout deep-dive, infographics, and video transmissions. Hold ground as a calm lighthouse: as NPC code flickers and EBS becomes the sole voice, the old AI timeline loses its anchor and the path clears for grand extraction and Second Realm restoration.

questions.question: What is the Communications Blackout engineered to do to the 3D overlay?

options.label: A
options.text: Shatter the false reality of the 3D overlay as a meticulously timed, deliberate operation for mass awakening.
options.rationale: The Communications Blackout is a meticulously timed, deliberate operation engineered to shatter the false reality of the 3D overlay.

options.label: B
options.text: Permanently reinforce the 3D overlay so no mass awakening or Frequency Fracture can ever begin.
options.rationale: The blackout shatters false reality and initiates Frequency Fracture; it does not reinforce the overlay permanently.

options.label: C
options.text: Upgrade every streaming service while leaving parasitic control systems fully connected to the population.
options.rationale: The blackout severs parasitic control connections and conventional communications; it is not a streaming upgrade.

options.label: D
options.text: Serve only as a random weather outage with no link to mass awakening or narrative collapse.
options.rationale: The event is deliberate and timed for mass awakening and narrative collapse, not a random weather outage.

questions.hint: A meticulously timed operation aimed at false reality itself.

questions.question: What critical window does the blackout initiate as the initial trigger for mass awakening?

options.label: A
options.text: Only a five-minute cable glitch that restores full parasitic media before any panic can form instead of initiating The First 72 Hours of transition with field clearing.
options.rationale: The window is three days of structured transition after full cable severing, not a five-minute restore.

options.label: B
options.text: A voluntary media festival that keeps every communication line online without field clearing instead of initiating The First 72 Hours of transition with field clearing.
options.rationale: Communications are cut and the energetic field clears; it is not a voluntary festival with lines online.

options.label: C
options.text: The First 72 Hours of transition, plunging the programmed world into temporary panic while clearing the energetic field.
options.rationale: The blackout initiates The First 72 Hours of transition, with temporary panic and simultaneous energetic-field clearing.

options.label: D
options.text: A permanent decade-long silence with no phased Cut, Wave, or Opening Hour structure at all instead of initiating The First 72 Hours of transition with field clearing.
options.rationale: The First 72 Hours is a critical three-day window in three phases—not a permanent decade without phases.

questions.hint: A three-day transition span immediately following the blackout.

questions.question: Beyond infrastructure failure, what is the true energetic nature of the blackout?

options.label: A
options.text: A permanent strengthening of parasitic control feeds so no Sol frequency can ever cut through.
options.rationale: The fracture severs parasitic connections so Resonating Sol frequencies can cut through the noise.

options.label: B
options.text: A simple router reboot with no effect on the 3D illusion or parasitic communication signals.
options.rationale: Removal of parasitic communication signals makes the 3D illusion physically and perceptually glitch.

options.label: C
options.text: A Frequency Fracture that severs the connection between parasitic control systems and the global population.
options.rationale: The blackout is a Frequency Fracture that severs parasitic control systems from the global population—not mere infrastructure failure.

options.label: D
options.text: A banking software update that only restarts ATMs without any field or narrative impact, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The blackout collapses artificial narrative and clears the energetic field—not an ATM-only software update.

questions.hint: A named fracture that severs parasitic systems from the global population.

questions.question: What does cutting conventional internet and communication lines force to collapse?

options.label: A
options.text: The artificial narrative, allowing true frequencies of Resonating Sols to cut through the noise and guide humanity out of the illusion.
options.rationale: Cutting conventional lines forces artificial-narrative collapse so Resonating Sol frequencies can guide humanity out of the illusion.

options.label: B
options.text: Military protection around community pockets so Sols must stand alone in every panic zone instead of collapsing artificial narrative so Resonating Sol frequencies cut through.
options.rationale: Sols remain in calm pockets protected by military presence; narrative collapse is not the removal of that protection.

options.label: C
options.text: Resonating Sol broadcast capacity so no true frequency can ever reach awakening people, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: Sol frequencies finally cut through; dormant codes switch into full broadcast mode rather than shutting down.

options.label: D
options.text: Only sports scores, while the artificial narrative and parasitic feeds continue uninterrupted forever instead of collapsing artificial narrative so Resonating Sol frequencies cut through.
options.rationale: The blackout collapses the artificial narrative itself, not merely sports scores on an intact parasitic feed.

questions.hint: The artificial story layer holding the illusion in place.

questions.question: What three phases make up The First 72 Hours after the blackout?

options.label: A
options.text: Only bank holidays with fully working internet and no communication blackout phases, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The phases assume severed communications and panic dynamics, not open-internet bank holidays.

options.label: B
options.text: The Cut, The Wave, and the Opening Hour as three distinct phases of the critical three-day window.
options.rationale: The First 72 Hours is categorized into The Cut, The Wave, and the Opening Hour.

options.label: C
options.text: Only permanent lockdown with no Cut, Wave, or Opening Hour sequence at any point, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The window is structured as Cut, Wave, and Opening Hour—not a single unstructured permanent lockdown alone.

options.label: D
options.text: Only Blue Beam holograms with no cable-cut phase and no crowd-surge wave at all, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The three phases begin with cable dark and include crowd surges; they are not Blue Beam-only stages.

questions.hint: Cut, Wave, and a named hour of first awakening cracks.

questions.question: What is an NPC Code Glitch in this context?

options.label: A
options.text: Perfect NPC stability with stronger artificial feeds and no erratic or dazed behavior at all instead of NPC and deep-sleeper breakdown when artificial information feeds cut off.
options.rationale: Glitching includes erratic lashing out or quiet dazed states—not perfect NPC stability with stronger feeds.

options.label: B
options.text: Behavioral breakdown of background simulation programs and deep sleepers cut off from their continuous feed of artificial information.
options.rationale: NPC Code Glitch is the behavioral breakdown of NPCs and deep sleepers when cut off from continuous artificial information.

options.label: C
options.text: Sol Memory Sharpening renamed, describing only awakened Sols with no NPC involvement instead of NPC and deep-sleeper breakdown when artificial information feeds cut off.
options.rationale: NPC Code Glitch targets background programs and deep sleepers; Sol Memory Sharpening is a separate Sol process.

options.label: D
options.text: A pure hardware cable brand name with no effect on sleeper or background-program behavior, so no severance from that system would ever be required.
options.rationale: NPC Code Glitch is behavioral breakdown in programs and sleepers, not merely a cable brand label.

questions.hint: Behavioral breakdown when continuous artificial information is cut off.

questions.question: What is Sol Memory Sharpening?

options.label: A
options.text: Permanent erasure of all Sol memory so no dormant codes can ever switch into broadcast mode, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: Sharpening activates dormant memory; dormant codes switch into full broadcast mode rather than being erased.

options.label: B
options.text: Spontaneous activation of dormant memory and clarity in true human and ET Sols when the parasitic overlay suddenly falls silent.
options.rationale: Sol Memory Sharpening is spontaneous activation of dormant memory and clarity in true human and ET Sols from sudden parasitic-overlay silence.

options.label: C
options.text: An MSM panic script that only deepens sleeper amnesia without any Sol clarity activation rather than Sol Memory Sharpening activating dormant clarity when the overlay goes silent.
options.rationale: Sol Memory Sharpening is Sol-side clarity activation, not an MSM script deepening sleeper amnesia.

options.label: D
options.text: A pure hardware firmware update for phones with no link to human or ET Sol consciousness rather than Sol Memory Sharpening activating dormant clarity when the overlay goes silent.
options.rationale: The process is spontaneous memory and clarity in true Sols, not a phone firmware update alone.

questions.hint: Dormant memory activation when parasitic overlay noise goes silent.

questions.question: Who engineers the blackout, and how is it pre-positioned in infrastructure?

options.label: A
options.text: It is purely accidental weather damage to satellites with no undersea cable role and no White Hat planning, disconnected from any deliberate long-game control design.
options.rationale: Undersea cables and parasitic nodes are structurally rigged; this is deliberate White Hat timing, not pure weather accident.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a controlled White Hat event pre-wired into the infrastructure, with certain parasitic nodes and undersea cables already structurally rigged for failure.
options.rationale: The blackout is a controlled White Hat event pre-wired into infrastructure; parasitic nodes and undersea cables are rigged for this moment.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a genuine unplanned geopolitical war with no White Hat control and no pre-rigged cable failures instead of a pre-wired White Hat event with undersea cables rigged for failure.
options.rationale: The blackout is controlled and pre-wired, not a genuine unplanned act of geopolitical war.

options.label: D
options.text: It is run solely by NPCs rewriting their own code without any infrastructure pre-wiring at all instead of a pre-wired White Hat event with undersea cables rigged for failure.
options.rationale: White Hats pre-wire infrastructure; NPCs glitch when feeds cut—they do not author the blackout operation.

questions.hint: White Hat control and cables already prepared for failure.

questions.question: How is the blackout deliberately masked when it occurs?

options.label: A
options.text: By immediate full disclosure that White Hats pre-wired every cable with zero false geopolitical blame, as the sole operative factor in the outcome.
options.rationale: The moment is deliberately masked with false geopolitical blame narratives, not immediate full White Hat disclosure.

options.label: B
options.text: By silence alone with no MSM panic, no blame narratives, and no fear-loop push on 3D Sleepers rather than false cyber-strike blame toward Russia, Iran, China, North Korea, and Ukraine.
options.rationale: Mainstream media and NPC channels flood with panic and blame to push 3D Sleepers into a fear loop.

options.label: C
options.text: By blaming only Resonating Sols for cutting cables to block EBS and truth forever rather than false cyber-strike blame toward Russia, Iran, China, North Korea, and Ukraine.
options.rationale: False blame targets named geopolitical actors, not Resonating Sols as the enemy narrative.

options.label: D
options.text: By a false narrative of cyber strikes and enemy actions blaming actors such as Russia, Iran, China, North Korea, and Ukraine.
options.rationale: The blackout is masked as cyber strikes and enemy actions with false blame on Russia, Iran, China, North Korea, and Ukraine.

questions.hint: False cyber-war framing and a list of blamed geopolitical actors.

questions.question: What immediate physical shift occurs when the main lines go down?

options.label: A
options.text: A permanent rise in pressure that densifies the parasitic overlay and muddies the field forever, keeping every neighboring mechanism off the board.
options.rationale: Pressure drops and the field clears; the shift does not densify the overlay permanently.

options.label: B
options.text: No atmospheric change at all—only a software error message on a few corporate servers instead of an atmospheric pressure pop clearing the field more than ever in history.
options.rationale: There is a sudden atmospheric pressure drop and palpable pop, not a server message with no field change.

options.label: C
options.text: Only louder traffic noise with no pressure drop and no momentary field clarity for Sols and no hidden harvest architecture behind the scenes.
options.rationale: Traffic noise later fades in stillness; the cable-down moment is a pressure pop and field clearing.

options.label: D
options.text: A sudden drop in atmospheric pressure felt as a pop, and for a split second the energetic field becomes clearer than ever in human history.
options.rationale: When main lines go down, atmospheric pressure drops as a pop and the field becomes clearer than ever in human history for a split second.

questions.hint: Atmospheric pressure sensation and field clarity relative to human history.

questions.question: What does that clarity allow dormant codes within Resonating Sols to do?

options.label: A
options.text: Only reboot NPC supermarket scripts with no magnetic pull on awakening people at all.
options.rationale: The activation is Sol-side broadcast pulling awakening attention, not NPC retail script reboots.

options.label: B
options.text: Switch into full broadcast mode, magnetically pulling the attention of those beginning to awaken.
options.rationale: Field clarity lets dormant codes in Resonating Sols switch into full broadcast mode and magnetically pull awakening attention.

options.label: C
options.text: Shut down permanently so no Sol can ever broadcast or draw awakening attention again.
options.rationale: Dormant codes switch into full broadcast mode—not permanent shutdown of Sol broadcast capacity.

options.label: D
options.text: Force every Sol into large panic crowds instead of calm community pockets during The Wave.
options.rationale: Sols are instructed to avoid panic zones; broadcast mode does not order them into crowd surges.

questions.hint: Broadcast mode and a magnetic effect on those beginning to awaken.

questions.question: What defines Phase One: The Cut (Hr. 0 – 12)?

options.label: A
options.text: Phase One only restocks fuel with no dark internet and no 3D Sleeper fear loop at all.
options.rationale: The Cut severs main cables and pushes sleepers into a fear loop—not a quiet fuel restock.

options.label: B
options.text: Internet and all communications go dark as main cables are severed.
options.rationale: Phase One (0–12) darkens all communications via severed main cables and floods MSM and NPC channels with panic-blame fear loops.

options.label: C
options.text: EBS already airs full tribunals while every cable stays online and MSM stays perfectly calm.
options.rationale: Phase One is cable dark and panic flooding; EBS readiness comes after isolation from parasitic media.

options.label: D
options.text: Only Sols lose signal while MSM praises geopolitical harmony with zero fear messaging.
options.rationale: All communications go dark and MSM floods with panic and blame, not harmony praise.

questions.hint: Dark communications and who is flooded with panic-blame content.

questions.question: What characterizes Phase Two: The Wave (Hr. 12 – 36)?

options.label: A
options.text: All military vanishes and no sleeper or NPC scrambles for survival or information at all.
options.rationale: Sleepers and NPCs scramble desperately; military presence protects calm community pockets.

options.label: B
options.text: Internet returns fully with calm shopping and zero visible NPC programming glitches.
options.rationale: The Wave is defined by survival scrambles and active NPC glitching under blackout conditions.

options.label: C
options.text: Everyone is ordered into the largest stadium crowds while Sols must amplify fear in every panic zone.
options.rationale: Sols must avoid large crowds and panic zones, not fill stadiums with more fear.

options.label: D
options.text: Panic peaks with surges at supermarkets, banks, and fuel stations.
options.rationale: Phase Two peaks panic at stores, banks, and fuel stations; NPCs glitch while Sols remain in small calm pockets protected by military presence.

questions.hint: Crowd targets, NPC glitch styles, Sol guidance, and military protection.

questions.question: What defines Phase Three: Opening Hour (Hr. 36 – 72)?

options.label: A
options.text: Awakening cracks appear as the false flag narrative wobbles and truth leaks.
options.rationale: Opening Hour brings awakening cracks, wobbling false flags, truth leaks, and recognition of a frequency fracture rather than a simple outage.

options.label: B
options.text: All NPC code becomes flawless and the event is officially labeled only as routine maintenance.
options.rationale: People realize it is a frequency fracture; NPC programming has been glitching rather than perfecting.

options.label: C
options.text: Phase Three only restocks banks with no awakening cracks and no Frequency Fracture recognition.
options.rationale: Opening Hour is about awakening cracks and Frequency Fracture truth, not mere bank restocking.

options.label: D
options.text: False-flag stories become permanently unchallengeable while no one questions the nature of the event.
options.rationale: The false flag narrative wobbles and people start questioning—not permanent unchallengeable false flags.

questions.hint: Awakening cracks, false flags, and recognition of the event’s true nature.

questions.question: What is The Static Build Up during the blackout window?

options.label: A
options.text: Only stock tickers freeze while phones, power grids, birds, dogs, and cats show zero change, with every larger system treated as clean, uninvolved, or beside the point.
options.rationale: Phones freeze, screens flicker, power surges hit, and animals react strongly—not ticker-only effects.

options.label: B
options.text: Total silence in every skull with perfect electronics and animals completely unaffected by the field rather than Static Build Up buzzing, glitches, surges, and animal reactions with extra water.
options.rationale: Static Build Up is buzzing, glitches, surges, and strong animal reactions—not unaffected silence.

options.label: C
options.text: A legal ban on yawning that ends all Drop in Tone and Sharp Edge symptoms forever, without extending the chain into harvest or inversion logistics rather than Static Build Up buzzing, glitches, surges, and animal reactions with extra water.
options.rationale: Static Build Up is an early symptom cluster; Drop in Tone and Sharp Edge still follow in sequence.

options.label: D
options.text: Subtle skull buzzing and white noise, glitching electronics and freezes, power surges, erratic birds, restless dogs near calm Sols, and cats disappearing to safe spots needing extra water.
options.rationale: Static Build Up includes skull buzzing, electronic glitches, power surges, and strong animal reactions including cats needing extra water.

questions.hint: Skull buzzing, electronics, and animal reactions including cats and water.

questions.question: What is The Drop in Tone as vessels experience it?

options.label: A
options.text: Only bank apps crash while bodies feel light and the Parasite Overlay looks more solid than ever instead of Drop in Tone tiredness, muted sky, and unexpected NPC emotional outbursts.
options.rationale: Drop in Tone signals overlay glitching with bodily heaviness and muted sky, not a more solid overlay.

options.label: B
options.text: A courtroom order banning tiredness with no biological or sky-tone changes during the window instead of Drop in Tone tiredness, muted sky, and unexpected NPC emotional outbursts.
options.rationale: Drop in Tone is lived vessel and atmospheric experience, not a legal ban on tiredness.

options.label: C
options.text: Sudden deep tiredness, unprovoked yawning, heavy chest, a muted flat sky as the Parasite Overlay glitches, and NPCs snapping or crying unexpectedly.
options.rationale: Drop in Tone includes deep tiredness, yawning, heavy chest, muted flat sky, and unexpected NPC emotional outbursts.

options.label: D
options.text: Unlimited sleeper energy with a brilliantly clear sky and perfectly calm NPC emotional states instead of Drop in Tone tiredness, muted sky, and unexpected NPC emotional outbursts.
options.rationale: The sign is tiredness, muted sky, and NPC outbursts—not unlimited energy and perfect NPC calm.

questions.hint: Tiredness, chest heaviness, sky quality, and NPC emotional outbursts.

questions.question: What marks The Sharp Edge during these intense shifts?

options.label: A
options.text: A permanent end to atmospheric pop effects before any main cable ever goes dark rather than Sharp Edge adrenaline, thicker air, and absence of birdsong.
options.rationale: Sharp Edge is a mid-sign cluster; Silence Before the Snap and the pressure pop still occur around cable dark.

options.label: B
options.text: Deep peaceful sleep for all, thinner air, and constant continuous birdsong at peak volume, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Sharp Edge is adrenaline and thicker air with absence of birdsong—not peaceful sleep and constant birds.

options.label: C
options.text: Short uncaused adrenaline bursts, sudden heart-rate spikes, thicker pre-storm air, and an absence of birdsong.
options.rationale: The Sharp Edge brings uncaused adrenaline, heart-rate spikes, thicker pre-storm air, and absence of birdsong.

options.label: D
options.text: Only political ads grow louder while hearts, air pressure feel, and birds remain unchanged.
options.rationale: Named markers are biological adrenaline, thicker air, and missing birdsong—not louder ads alone.

questions.hint: Adrenaline, air feel, and bird song status.

questions.question: What happens in The Silence Before the Snap?

options.label: A
options.text: Sharp high-pitch ear ringing just out of normal hearing range, plus profound stillness as traffic fades, wind pauses, and nature holds its breath.
options.rationale: Silence Before the Snap brings high-pitch ringing and profound stillness—traffic fades, wind pauses, nature holds its breath.

options.label: B
options.text: Cables stay fully lit while a silent movie plays on every phone with no field or stillness effect instead of ringing stillness as traffic fades, wind pauses, and nature holds its breath.
options.rationale: The sequence accompanies collapsing overlay around cable dark and pressure shift—not silent movies on live cables.

options.label: C
options.text: Noise doubles everywhere with no ear ringing and chaotic wind and traffic at maximum volume instead of ringing stillness as traffic fades, wind pauses, and nature holds its breath.
options.rationale: The sign is stillness and ringing—not doubled noise and chaotic peak traffic.

options.label: D
options.text: Nothing beyond stock markets open early with no stillness and no change in traffic, wind, or nature sound, and no coordinated multi-system design behind it.
options.rationale: Traffic noise fades and nature holds its breath; this is environmental stillness, not early market open alone.

questions.hint: Hearing sensation and environmental stillness before the snap.

questions.question: How is the Communications Blackout interconnected with larger staged events?

options.label: A
options.text: It permanently restores every parasitic media channel stronger than before the cables went dark rather than interconnection with Staged WW3 and Fake Alien Invasion isolation dynamics.
options.rationale: The blackout isolates masses from parasitic media so EBS can become the sole voice of truth.

options.label: B
options.text: It only restarts local sports leagues with no fear loop and no isolation from narrative control, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: The blackout drives uncertainty and a fear loop toward EBS readiness, not sports-league restarts alone.

options.label: C
options.text: It has no link to WW3 or alien invasion staging and never isolates anyone from parasitic media feeds in any density, cycle, or historical configuration.
options.rationale: The blackout is explicitly interconnected with those staged events and isolates the public from parasitic media.

options.label: D
options.text: It is deeply interconnected with the Staged WW3 Event and the Fake Alien Invasion, plunging masses into uncertainty and isolating them from parasitic media.
options.rationale: The blackout interconnects with Staged WW3 and Fake Alien Invasion, creating uncertainty and isolation from parasitic media.

questions.hint: Two major staged fear theaters are named alongside the blackout.

questions.question: How does the resulting fear loop prepare the public for the E.B.S.?

options.label: A
options.text: By cancelling all tribunals and sealing election fraud and trafficking evidence forever, keeping every neighboring mechanism off the board.
options.rationale: EBS prepares to broadcast undeniable truth of those crimes—not to seal them forever.

options.label: B
options.text: By restoring every MSM channel so EBS remains optional background noise no one has to hear instead of EBS becoming the sole voice for fraud, trafficking, and replaced-elite crimes.
options.rationale: Other sources are removed so EBS is the sole voice—not optional background under full MSM restore.

options.label: C
options.text: By keeping multiple competing foreign news feeds online so no single truth voice can dominate instead of EBS becoming the sole voice for fraud, trafficking, and replaced-elite crimes.
options.rationale: The design removes other sources so EBS alone carries the disclosure content.

options.label: D
options.text: By removing all other information sources so EBS becomes the sole voice ready to broadcast election fraud, trafficking rings, and crimes of the replaced elites.
options.rationale: Fear readiness plus removal of other sources makes EBS the sole voice for election fraud, trafficking, and replaced-elite crimes.

questions.hint: Sole voice status and the categories of truth to be broadcast.

questions.question: Why is the blackout a vital precursor to the arrival of the Real Craft?

options.label: A
options.text: It forces realm frequencies to shift, dropping holograms so true Solar Families can break through into visibility for those on the correct frequency.
options.rationale: The blackout shifts realm frequencies, drops holograms, and lets true Solar Families become visible on the correct frequency.

options.label: B
options.text: It blocks all Solar Family signals so only Fake Alien Invasion holograms remain forever rather than shifting frequencies so Real Craft and Solar Families become visible.
options.rationale: The blackout drops holograms and allows true Solar Families through for those on the correct frequency.

options.label: C
options.text: It permanently locks holograms in place so Solar Families can never become visible to anyone rather than shifting frequencies so Real Craft and Solar Families become visible.
options.rationale: Holograms drop and Solar Families break through into visibility—not permanent hologram lock.

options.label: D
options.text: It only reboots NPC grocery drones with no frequency shift and no Real Craft pathway, keeping every neighboring mechanism off the board.
options.rationale: The precursor role is frequency shift and Real Craft / Solar Family visibility, not grocery drones alone.

questions.hint: Frequency shift, holograms, and Solar Families becoming visible.

questions.question: What is the specific role of Resonating Sols during The First 72 Hours?

options.label: A
options.text: To shut down completely and refuse any lighthouse role until long after Second Realm restoration ends.
options.rationale: The awakened role is active calm lighthouse presence through the 72 hours, not total shutdown.

options.label: B
options.text: To lead every supermarket panic surge and amplify fear loops across the largest crowds possible.
options.rationale: Sols avoid large crowds and panic zones and act as calm lighthouses—not fear amplifiers.

options.label: C
options.text: To rewrite MSM blame scripts so the artificial narrative regains full control during The Cut.
options.rationale: Sols hold calm ground as narrative collapses; they do not restore artificial MSM control.

options.label: D
options.text: To hold ground as calm lighthouses while the scaffolding of the AI illusion crumbles around them.
options.rationale: For Resonating Sols the blackout is the call to hold ground as calm lighthouses while AI-illusion scaffolding crumbles.

questions.hint: A lighthouse metaphor while AI scaffolding crumbles.

questions.question: How do deeply programmed sleepers and NPCs respond to help for the first 48 hours?

options.label: A
options.text: They resist help, preferring fear over admitting the reality of the situation during those first 48 hours.
options.rationale: For the first 48 hours, deeply programmed sleepers and NPCs resist help, preferring fear over admitting reality.

options.label: B
options.text: They only sleep peacefully with no fear preference and no resistance to Resonating Army frequency.
options.rationale: They prefer fear and resist help; later Resonating Army frequency cuts through as code flickers out.

options.label: C
options.text: They become sole EBS broadcasters replacing White Hats with perfect calm authority on day one.
options.rationale: Sleepers and NPCs are in resistance and glitch states; EBS is the disclosure voice after isolation, not NPC-run day-one calm authority.

options.label: D
options.text: They immediately accept all help and fully admit the Frequency Fracture within the first hour.
options.rationale: They resist help for the first 48 hours rather than immediately admitting reality.

questions.hint: Resistance pattern and preference over admitting reality.

questions.question: As the 72 hours progress and NPC code flickers out, what does the Resonating Army’s stabilized frequency do?

options.label: A
options.text: It permanently fails so only parasitic media can cut through the chaos after hour seventy-two.
options.rationale: Stabilized Resonating Army frequency cuts through chaos; parasitic media is already severed.

options.label: B
options.text: It effortlessly cuts through the chaos as NPC code flickers out and Sol presence stabilizes the field.
options.rationale: As NPC code flickers out, the Resonating Army’s stabilized frequency effortlessly cuts through the chaos.

options.label: C
options.text: It forces every Sol into panic zones instead of calm lighthouse roles in community pockets.
options.rationale: Sols remain calm lighthouses in protected pockets; army frequency cuts through chaos, not into panic leadership.

options.label: D
options.text: It only reboots undersea cables for parasitic feeds without affecting NPC code or chaos levels.
options.rationale: The army frequency cuts through chaos as NPC code flickers—not a reboot of parasitic cable feeds.

questions.hint: How stabilized frequency relates to chaos.

questions.question: What long-term path does the blackout clear by breaking the old AI timeline anchor?

options.label: A
options.text: It cancels all Solar Family visibility and freezes holograms as the final permanent reality story, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Holograms drop for Solar Family visibility, and the path opens to Second Realm restoration—not permanent hologram freeze.

options.label: B
options.text: It locks the masses permanently into the old AI timeline with no extraction path and no Second Realm restoration.
options.rationale: The blackout prevents re-anchoring the old AI timeline and clears extraction and Second Realm restoration.

options.label: C
options.text: It only restarts density loops stronger than before with no grand extraction planned at all rather than breaking the old AI timeline for grand extraction and Second Realm restoration.
options.rationale: The operation permanently breaks the density cycle rather than restarting stronger density loops.

options.label: D
options.text: It permanently breaks the cycle of density and clears the path for grand extraction and restoration of the Second Realm.
options.rationale: The blackout ensures masses cannot re-anchor the old AI timeline, breaking density’s cycle and clearing grand extraction and Second Realm restoration.

questions.hint: Density cycle, extraction, and a named realm restoration.
